name: Card
summary: The main surface for grouped content, with optional header, media, footer, link and feature styles.
description: Use a card for one self-contained thing: a project, a plan, a summary. For a plain bordered box with sections that run edge to edge, use a panel.

classes.name: v-card
classes.description: The card: padded, bordered, with the direction's shadow and sheen. Its children stack with a gap. On an <a> the whole card is a link and lifts on hover.

classes.name: v-card-header
classes.description: A row with the title at the start and a badge or action at the end.

classes.name: v-card-title
classes.description: The card heading, in the display font.

classes.name: v-card-text
classes.description: Body text in the secondary text colour.

classes.name: v-card-footer
classes.description: A row of actions under a rule.

classes.name: v-card-media
classes.description: An image (first child) that bleeds to the card's top and side edges.

classes.name: v-card-feature
classes.description: The direction's emphasis surface, for the one card that should stand out. Text and border tokens are remapped inside.

a11y: Use a real heading (h2, h3) for .v-card-title so cards show up in the page outline.
A link card is one link: keep buttons and other links out of it, or they nest inside the link.
The link card shows the focus ring around the whole card.
Text inside the feature card is checked for contrast against the feature surface in every direction and theme.
